description: Records something already paid (a receipt: fuel, supplies, a meal) as a draft expense: vendor, date, lines, taxes, total and what it was paid from. When the user gives a photo or PDF of a receipt or bill, read it yourself and pass what is printed: the vendor, date, each line, each tax and the total. When you can read the file's actual bytes (a file you were given by path or as an attachment your tools can open), also pass them as fileBase64 so the photo is attached to the draft (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, HEIC or PDF, at most 10 MB). Never write base64 from what you see in an image; without the real file, leave fileBase64 out and tell the user to attach the photo to the draft in the app. It is created as a DRAFT: nothing is posted, paid or sent. Tell the user it is waiting for them in Mobile Accounting (openInApp).

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

currency.description: ISO currency when not the books' own (USD, CAD, EUR...).

fileBase64.description: The receipt file itself, base64 (optional; only the file's real bytes).

category.description: Or a category name, matched exactly (optional).

description.description: What it was for (for example "Printer paper").

notes.description: A note for the person who reviews it.

paidFrom.description: BANK (debit or bank transfer), CREDIT_CARD, CASH, or OWNER (paid personally by an owner).

taxes.description: Each tax printed on the receipt.

label.description: The tax as printed (GST, HST, PST, QST, VAT, sales tax...).

total.description: The total paid, to check the lines and taxes add up.

vendor.description: Who was paid, as printed on the receipt.

name: record_expense
title: Record an expense (draft)
